<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>

Gives back a paginated list of the people who can be offered as testers, before an app or a tester group exists. Returns the workspace members, plus the outside contributors of the project when `project_id` is given. Service accounts are never listed, so the caller's own token may not appear. A member who has not accepted their invitation yet has no `username` and is carried by email alone. `already_member` is always `false` here: this route has no tester group to compare against, and the flag means "already in that group", never "already a tester on the app". Call /tester-groups/\{id\}/potential-testers when the flag is needed.
